description:
HushThreads v0.0.3 keeps the same 6 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (com.instagram.barcelona). They're Hide ads, Sanitize sharing links, Disable analytics, Remove the advertising ID, Restore screens on re-signed builds and HushThreads settings. Hide ads and Sanitize sharing links now stop patching when a build offers more than one place to patch, and Restore screens no longer trips over a failed Android lookup.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password. Continue as the Instagram account already on your phone isn't offered on a patched Threads yet. A reported password rejection hasn't been reproduced, and this bundle hasn't been installed on a phone yet.

Validation: 371 runtime tests passed locally. All 109 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 6 patches applied to Threads 449.0.0.54.82 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 449.0.0.54.82, version code 511908382. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
